aboutUs.title: About BetterWash
paragraphs: BetterWash was born from a simple belief — everyone deserves access to premium, natural skincare products. Founded in 2023, we set out to create a brand that combines the best of nature and science.

Our products are crafted with carefully selected natural ingredients, free from harmful chemicals, and designed to deliver real results. From our herbal shampoos to our hydrating moisturizers, every product reflects our commitment to quality and your well-being.

  • Usage Data: Information about how you browse our website, including pages visited, time spent, and device information.
  • Communication Data: Messages sent via WhatsApp, email, or contact forms.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use the collected information for the following purposes:

  • Processing and fulfilling your product orders.
  • Responding to your inquiries and providing customer support.
  • Sending order updates and delivery notifications.
  • Improving our website experience and product offerings.
  • Sending promotional offers and newsletters (only with your consent).

3. Data Protection

We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

4. Third-Party Sharing

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your data only with:

  • Delivery partners for order fulfillment.
  • Payment processors for secure transactions.
  • Legal authorities when required by law.

5. Cookies

Our website may use cookies to enhance your browsing experience. You can disable cookies through your browser settings at any time.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can opt out of promotional communications at any time.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions about our Privacy Policy, please contact us at deepanshg31@gmail.com or +91 95842 51250.
